written.headline: OpenAI launches Decisions API with voice, visual inputs at $0.10 per million tokens
written.summary: OpenAI made its Decisions API generally available on Oct 22 2026, charging $0.10 per million input tokens and nothing for output. The API adds voice and visual modalities and delivers latency around 150 ms, up to ten‑times faster than standard GPT‑6 Luna calls.

written.headline: Microsoft diagnostic orchestrator reaches 83% accuracy in complex case simulation
written.summary: Microsoft's Diagnostic Orchestrator (MAI‑DxO) correctly diagnosed complex medical cases 83% of the time in a simulation, compared with 36% for generalist physicians using reference materials. The system also achieved about 80% accuracy on emergency department cases versus roughly 47% for physicians.

written.headline: Pathos AI partners with Bristol Myers Squibb and Tempus AI on Alzheimer drug development
written.summary: Pathos AI announced a multi‑year collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb and Tempus AI, licensing a $55 million, five‑year dataset and applying its Pathos Foundry AI platform to accelerate Alzheimer’s and other neurological drug research. The deal coincides with a $237 million Series E round led by Bristol Myers, valuing Pathos at about $3 billion.
